resources.string: Type the address of the MTG gateway you were given, for example mtg.example.com. The app opens that site and signs you in there.
Could not reach that address. Check the spelling and your connection.
That address answered (HTTP %1$d) but does not look like an MTG gateway.
That is not a valid address.
The gateway must be reached over https.
Leave the user name and password out of the address.
Version %1$s of the app is available.
Android is installing the update. The app closes when it is done; open it again from its icon. If Android asks, allow installs from this app and confirm.
This build of the app does not look for updates. Get new versions from your gateway\'s Android app page.
Could not reach GitHub to look for an update. Check the connection and try again.
Version %1$s is out, but it is signed with a different key than this app, so Android would refuse it. Get the app from your gateway\'s Android app page.
The update did not download completely. Try again later.
The downloaded file is not the expected version of this app, so it was not installed.
Android wants you to confirm the update. Open the app and tap Update again.
The page could not be loaded. Check your connection, then tap Retry.
No connection to your gateway. Check that the phone is online, then tap Retry.
Your gateway is not answering right now (it may be restarting). Wait a minute, then tap Retry.
The page stopped unexpectedly and was reloaded.
Your sign-in has ended. Reload the page, sign in again and retry the download.
No app can open that link.
No browser is installed to sign in with. Use "Sign in inside the app instead" on the page.
That sign-in wasn\'t started here or has expired. Sign in again from the app.
Camera permission is needed to scan cards.
The camera is turned off for this app. Turn on Camera under Permissions, then come back and tap Scan again.
This gateway\'s scan page has no photo hooks; it needs a newer gateway version.
The scan page did not take the photo. Tap Done, reload the page and try again.
The scan page did not answer in time. Tap Done and check the page.
This gateway has no scan page.
A page from another site tried to open inside the app and was stopped. Tap Retry to go back to your gateway.
This app opens links to your gateway (%1$s) and archidekt.com deck links. That link is neither, so it was not opened.
There was no https link in what was shared. Share a link to your gateway or an archidekt.com deck link.
Camera error (%1$d). Close and try again.
Fill the dashed box with the card, then tap Shoot.
Torch brightness is adjustable on this phone. Fill the dashed box with the card, then tap Shoot.
Torch brightness control needs Android 15. Fill the dashed box with the card, then tap Shoot.
This camera does not report adjustable torch brightness. Fill the dashed box with the card, then tap Shoot.
Auto: hold each card in the dashed box until it is added.
Auto off. Tap Shoot for one card at a time.
Not sure: %1$s. Tap Done to check it on the page.
Could not place “%1$s”; kept in the unidentified list.
No card outline found. Use a plain, contrasting background.
Found a match. Tap Done to add it on the page; Shoot again replaces it.
Auto paused: a read waits on the page. Tap Done to check it.
